question: Business requirements description for a Farmland Management Information System: The system needs to manage multiple farms, with each farm recording farm ID, farm owner name, owner type (company or individual), owner contact information, and address. Each farm can have multiple plots of land. Each plot has a plot ID, area, soil type, crops, and current status (such as "sowing", "growing", "harvesting", etc.). Each crop has an ID, name, growth cycle, suitable soil type, and suitable climate conditions. For each planting operation, the system needs to record plot ID, crop, planting time, expected harvest time, planting quantity, and operator. For each harvesting operation, the system needs to record plot ID, crop, harvest time, harvest quantity, and operator.
ddl:
-- Schema for database: rschema_0187

CREATE TABLE farms (
  farm_id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  farm_owner_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  owner_type ENUM('company', 'individual') NOT NULL,
  owner_contact_info VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  address VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (farm_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE plots (
  plot_id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  farm_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  area DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
  soil_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  crops VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  current_status VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (plot_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (farm_id) REFERENCES farms (farm_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE crops (
  crop_id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  growth_cycle VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  suitable_soil_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  suitable_climate_conditions VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (crop_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE planting_operations (
  plot_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  crop_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  planting_time DATETIME NOT NULL,
  expected_harvest_time DATETIME NOT NULL,
  planting_quantity INT(11) NOT NULL,
  operator VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (plot_id, crop_id, planting_time),
  FOREIGN KEY (plot_id) REFERENCES plots (plot_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (crop_id) REFERENCES crops (crop_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE harvesting_operations (
  plot_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  crop_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  harvest_time DATETIME NOT NULL,
  harvest_quantity INT(11) NOT NULL,
  operator VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (plot_id, crop_id, harvest_time),
  FOREIGN KEY (plot_id) REFERENCES plots (plot_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (crop_id) REFERENCES crops (crop_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
